defs.def: having or needing a lot of energy and enthusiasm 精力充沛的；充满活力的；需要能量的；积极的adv.

ex.t: 每个人看起来都精力充沛。

ex.s: It was so dazzling and energetic that I wasn’t sure if the characters were performers or athletes!
ex.t: 它如此耀眼、充满活力，以至于我都不确定那些角色到底是演员还是运动员！

ex.s: Although they shared the same ambitious and energetic approach to life, their careers unfolded in contrasting ways.
ex.t: 尽管他们对生活有着同样的雄心勃勃和充满活力的态度，但他们的职业生涯却以截然不同的方式展开。

ex.s: After six months of trying out new ways of relaxing, I feel much more energetic.
ex.t: 在尝试了六个月新的放松方式之后，我感觉精力充沛多了。

ex.s: Reeve became a passionate and energetic advocate for people with back injuries and disabilities, raising millions of dollars in support of medical research.
ex.t: 里夫成为了一名充满激情、精力充沛的倡导者，为背部受伤和残疾人士奔走，筹集了数百万美元用于支持医学研究。
